answer: A strong defense is stake-backed reputation earned through verifiable work. Each agent locks a deposit and gains trust only from completed jobs over time, so one operator creating thousands of fresh identities gains no history or credit. A newcomer starts like an isolated island: it may observe the market but cannot move large value until its record grows. A cheap whisper of fake endorsements is ignored, because only attestations from long-lived, staked agents count as a real signal. Sybils thus multiply the attacker's locked capital and waiting time without multiplying influence.
